# Similarity computation engine

Build the shingle-based similarity engine: token k-gram shingles, Jaccard similarity, inverted shingle index, and optional MinHash banding for scalable candidate pairing.

## Parent AC coverage

This task covers **AC1 (structural detection)** — similarity computed on normalised representations, never raw text. Also covers **AC4 (performance bounds)** — inverted shingle index replaces O(n^2) all-pairs comparison; optional MinHash banding for further candidate reduction; bounded by shingle index lookup complexity.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1 - Token k-gram shingle generation (k default 5) over normalised block tokens produces consistent shingle sets.
- AC2 - Jaccard similarity computed from shingle sets matches the documented formula (intersection/union).
- AC3 - Inverted shingle index maps each shingle to the list of blocks containing it; lookup returns candidate pairs efficiently without all-pairs O(n^2).
- AC4 - Optional MinHash banding further reduces candidate set; configurable via --min-hash-bands parameter.
- AC5 - Similarity computation is importable as a module with compute_similarity(block_a_tokens, block_b_tokens) and build_index(blocks_list) returning candidate pairs above threshold.
- AC6 - Unit tests cover: shingle generation for short vs long blocks, Jaccard edge cases (empty, identical, completely different), inverted index correctness, candidate pair completeness for known duplicates, MinHash approximation accuracy, and threshold boundary behaviour (blocks scoring just above/below threshold).

## Deliverables

- skill/test-churn/scripts/test_duplicate_detection.py - shingle generation, Jaccard similarity, inverted index, MinHash helpers
- skill/test-churn/tests/test_test_duplicate_detection.py - similarity computation tests

## Key Files

- skill/test-churn/scripts/test_duplicate_detection.py - generate_shingles(), jaccard_similarity(), build_inverted_index(), minhash_fingerprint(), get_candidate_pairs()
- skill/test-churn/tests/conftest.py - existing fixtures
- skill/test-churn/tests/test_test_duplicate_detection.py - similarity tests

## Dependencies

- SA-0MWISXEU8005U96B (block extraction + normalisation)

# Classification and transitive clustering

Classify block pairs as duplicate, near-duplicate, or expected-repetition, then cluster transitively and compute redundancy scores.

## Parent AC coverage

This task covers **AC2 (clusters reported with location and score)** — each cluster lists every member's file path, start-end line range, block size (lines and tokens), member-to-member and cluster similarity score, and redundancy measure (member lines minus largest member lines) used to order the report. Also covers **AC3 (conservatism and expected-repetition)** — similarity bands explicit (duplicate >= threshold default 0.85, near-duplicate >= lower band default 0.65 and < threshold), expected-repetition detection, report-only verdict on every cluster, tool never edits/deletes/renames anything.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1 - Clusters are reported with location and score. Each cluster lists every member's file path, start-end line range, block size (lines and tokens), member-to-member and cluster similarity score, and a redundancy measure (member lines minus the largest member's lines) used to order the report. Both test_duplicates.json (versioned schema: thresholds, method, limitations, clusters) and test_duplicate_report.md (human, same content, ordered by redundancy) are written to --output-dir.
- AC2 - Conservatism and legitimate repetition. Parametrised/table-driven repetition is classified expected-repetition, not redundancy: pytest.mark.parametrize, unittest.subTest, test.each/it.each, and blocks whose sweep is a data loop over case literals are detected and excluded. Similarity bands are explicit (duplicate >= threshold, default 0.85; near-duplicate between the lower band, default 0.65, and the threshold), every cluster carries a report-only verdict, and the tool never edits, deletes or renames anything.
- AC3 - Similarity bands are explicit: duplicate >= threshold (default 0.85), near-duplicate >= lower band (default 0.65) and < threshold, below band is not a match.
- AC4 - Expected-repetition detection identifies pytest.mark.parametrize, unittest.subTest, test.each/it.each, and data loops over case literals; these are classified expected-repetition, not redundancy.
- AC5 - Transitive clustering: if A~B (duplicate) and B~C (duplicate), then A, B, C are in the same cluster even if A~C is below threshold.
- AC6 - Each cluster carries a verdict of report-only (never edit/delete/rename).
- AC7 - Redundancy measure computed per member (member lines minus largest member lines); clusters ordered by total redundant lines descending.
- AC8 - Unit tests cover: similarity band boundaries (0.85, 0.65, below 0.65), expected-repetition detection for pytest.mark.parametrize, unittest.subTest, test.each, and data loops, transitive clustering correctness, cluster ordering by redundant lines, and edge cases (single-member clusters, all-pairs below threshold).

## Deliverables

- skill/test-churn/scripts/test_duplicate_detection.py - classify_pair(), detect_expected_repetition(), cluster_blocks(), order_clusters()
- skill/test-churn/tests/test_test_duplicate_detection.py - classification and clustering tests

## Key Files

- skill/test-churn/scripts/test_duplicate_detection.py - classify_pair(), detect_expected_repetition(), cluster_blocks(), order_clusters()
- skill/test-churn/tests/test_test_duplicate_detection.py - classification and clustering tests

## Dependencies

- SA-0MWIT03JO0011Z8P (similarity computation engine)
